name: Canh la lim kim
summary: Canh lá lìm kìm is the everyday soup VnExpress makes with the same leaf, tôm, and tép. Do not add salt. The leaf is already salty, and the shrimp is sweet. A little seasoning and ground pepper finish it.
origin: Can Gio. VnExpress, 22 Sep 2021. A home pot, not a named stall.
howToEat: Cook it for an ordinary meal. The story says no salt goes in.
